summary: Masonglory Limited, a Hong Kong construction contractor, furnished a Form 6-K confirming the October 5, 2026 closing of its previously announced private placement. The company sold 667,000 Class A ordinary shares at US$1.50 per share for gross proceeds of US$1,000,500 to four unaffiliated purchasers, plus Series A warrants for 667,000 shares at US$1.30 and Series B warrants for 667,000 shares at US$1.10, both with two-year terms. No purchaser holds 5% or more post-closing. Securities were issued offshore under Regulation S-type exemptions as restricted securities, posing dilution and warrant-overhang risk.
